source: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - G.S.R. 202(E), 7th March 2011

applicability.applies_to: retail packages intended for sale to ultimate consumer
exclusions: packages of commodities containing quantity more than 25 kg or 25 litre (except cement/fertilizer bags up to 50kg)
packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers
packaged commodities meant for institutional consumers (transport, airways, railways, hotels, hospitals buying directly from manufacturer)

mandatory_declarations.label: Name and address of manufacturer/packer/importer
mandatory_declarations.notes: If manufacturer is not the packer, both manufacturer and packer name+address required. For imported packages, importer's name and address required. Complete address = postal address of factory, OR city+state+PIN code.
mandatory_declarations.special_rule: If name/address appears WITHOUT qualifying words 'manufactured by' or 'packed by', it is presumed to be the manufacturer (Explanation I, Rule 6).

mandatory_declarations.label: Common or generic name of the commodity
mandatory_declarations.notes: If package contains more than one product, name and quantity of each product required.

mandatory_declarations.label: Net quantity in standard unit of weight/measure/number
mandatory_declarations.notes: Weight of wrappers/packaging materials must be excluded from net quantity.

mandatory_declarations.label: Month and year of manufacture/pre-packing/import
exemptions: domestic LPG cylinder (14.2kg or 5kg) marketed by public sector undertaking
food articles (governed instead by Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954)

mandatory_declarations.label: Retail Sale Price (MRP)
mandatory_format_patterns: Maximum or Max. retail price Rs..../₹.... inclusive of all taxes
MRP Rs..../₹.... incl. of all taxes
exemptions: domestic LPG cylinder priced under Administrative Price Mechanism
alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor (governed by State Excise Laws instead, unless those laws don't cover MRP)

mandatory_declarations.label: Dimensions of commodity (only if size is relevant)
mandatory_declarations.notes: Applies to bed-sheets, fabric, dhoties, sarees, napkins, pillow-covers, towels, table cloths, etc. (Rule 14). If pieces have different dimensions, each must be declared separately.

mrp_format_check.requirement: Numerals of retail sale price and net quantity must be printed/painted/inscribed in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the label background
exceptions: information blown/formed/moulded on glass or plastic surface
handwritten declarations (must instead be clear, unambiguous, legible)

sticker_rules.not_permitted: Individual stickers to alter or make any mandatory declaration
sticker_rules.permitted_exception: Sticker for reducing MRP (must show revised lower MRP inclusive of all taxes, must not cover the original manufacturer/packer MRP declaration)
sticker_rules.fully_permitted: Stickers for any declaration NOT required under these rules

width_rule.requirement: width of letter or numeral shall not be less than one-third of its height

table_1_weight_volume_numerals.applies_when: net_quantity declared in terms of weight or volume

table_2_length_area_number.applies_when: net_quantity declared in terms of length, area, or number

font_size_rules.exemption: Sub-rules (1)-(3) of Rule 7 do not apply if the same info is already required under another law in force.

clear_space_around_quantity_declaration.above_below: space at least equal to the height of the numeral in the declaration
clear_space_around_quantity_declaration.left_right: space at least twice the height of the numeral in the declaration

placement_rules.special_case_soft_drinks: for returnable soft drink/beverage bottles, MRP may appear on crown cap or bottle, sufficient if shown as 'MRP Rs..../₹......'

manner_of_declaration.liquid_commodities: no declaration shall require reading through the liquid commodity
manner_of_declaration.outer_wrapper_rule: if package has outer container/wrapper, it must also carry all required declarations, UNLESS wrapper is transparent and inner declarations are easily readable through it

language.note: additional languages may be used IN ADDITION to Hindi/English, not as substitute

principal_display_panel_definition.definition: total surface area of package where required info is given
grouping_options: all information grouped together at one place
pre-printed info grouped at one place, online/variable info grouped at another place
principal_display_panel_definition.area_calculation_exclusions: top, bottom, flange at top/bottom of cans, shoulders and neck of bottles/jars excluded from area calculation

shape_based_area_rule.rectangular: one side = principal display panel (area of that side)

standard_package_sizes.requirement: commodities listed in Second Schedule must be packed only in specified standard quantities
standard_package_sizes.non_standard_size_declaration_required: 'Not a standard pack size under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011' OR 'non standard size under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011'

sample_entries.standard_sizes: below 50g in multiples of 10g; 50g, 100g, 200g, 500g, 750g, 1kg, 2kg, 5kg, then multiples of 5kg
below 50g no restriction; 50g, 100g, 200g, 500g, 1kg, then multiples of 500g

deceptive_packaging.definition: a package designed to deliberately give an exaggerated or misleading impression of the quantity of commodity contained
valid_justification_for_larger_size: necessary for protection of the commodity contained
necessary to meet requirements of the filling machine used
deceptive_packaging.consequence: manufacturer/packer required to repack and re-label; failure leads to seizure

required_fields: name and address of manufacturer/importer, or packer if different
total number of retail packages OR net quantity in standard units
wholesale_package_declarations.note: lighter requirement than retail packages; does not apply if similar declaration already required under another law

advertisement_rule.requirement: any advertisement mentioning MRP must also declare net quantity or number of commodity
advertisement_rule.font_size_requirement: font size of net quantity in the advertisement must equal font size of MRP in the advertisement
advertisement_rule.relevance: applicable if system is extended to check e-commerce/online product listings, not just physical labels

rule_10_manufacturer_address_detail.complete_address_definition: postal address at which factory is situated, OR name of street+city+state, OR PIN code sufficient to identify/locate manufacturer/packer/importer
rule_10_manufacturer_address_detail.small_package_exception: packages of capacity 5 cubic cm or less: sufficient if a mark/inscription enables consumer to identify manufacturer/packer/importer
rule_10_manufacturer_address_detail.foreign_manufactured_goods_packed_in_ind: must additionally show name and complete address of the packer or importer in India on principal display panel

quantity_declaration_rules.no_qualifying_words_like_when_packed: declaration must not be qualified by words 'when packed' etc. UNLESS commodity is one listed in Third Schedule (soaps, lotions, creams) which is subject to environmental variation

unit_selection_rules.mass: for solid, semi-solid, viscous, or solid+liquid mixture commodities
unit_selection_rules.length: for commodities sold by linear measure
unit_selection_rules.area: for commodities sold by area measure

font_size_check_logic.description: Pseudocode logic for the compliance engine to determine minimum required font size for a scanned product
steps: 1. Determine if net_quantity is declared by weight/volume OR by length/area/number
2. If weight/volume: look up net_quantity value in font_size_rules.table_1_weight_volume_numerals.slabs to get required minimum mm
3. If length/area/number: calculate/estimate principal display panel area, look up in font_size_rules.table_2_length_area_number.slabs

4. Measure actual numeral height in mm from image (using reference-object calibration: pixels_per_mm = reference_object_pixel_width / reference_object_known_mm_width; then numeral_height_mm = numeral_height_px / pixels_per_mm)
5. Compare actual_height_mm >= required_minimum_mm -> PASS else FAIL
6. Separately check general letter height (non-numeral) >= 1mm (or 2mm if surface is blown/moulded/embossed) per Rule 7(3)
7. Check width of letters/numerals >= (height / 3), except for '1','i','I','l'
